caption:
Windforce profit up 11% 🌬️☀️📈

July to September 2026 results: sales rose 17% to Rs 2.99 billion. Operating profit grew 16.5% to Rs 1.32 billion.

Profit to shareholders rose 10.7% to Rs 848 million. For the six months, profit is up 6.9% to Rs 1.61 billion. The company is building new battery storage sites.

Source: Windforce PLC interim financial statements, CSE

Sampath Bank profit up 15% 🏦📈

July to September 2026 results: net interest income rose 25.7% to Rs 25.27 billion.

Profit to shareholders grew 15.4% to Rs 8.68 billion. For the nine months, profit is up 14.6% to Rs 26.54 billion. Bad loans fell to 6.07% of loans, from 8.37%.

Source: Sampath Bank PLC interim financial statements, CSE

LAUGFS Power net profit up 315% ⚡📈

July to September 2026 results: revenue rose 25% to Rs 257 million. Gross profit grew 36% to Rs 157 million.

Operating profit more than doubled, up 113% to Rs 113 million. Net profit jumped 315% to Rs 64 million, and the net profit margin rose to 25%.
